migrationRule: KEEP only byte-identical assets already registered as Unity resources; otherwise DISCARD from Unity scope until a verified consumer/destination exists. PORT requires explicit evidence and is not inferred from filenames.

estimates.rgba8DecodedEstimateFormula: width * height * 4; a raw pixel-memory upper-level estimate, not Unity runtime memory or GPU allocation evidence.
estimates.actualUnityBuildSize: Not measured. No Unity import/build was run; platform compression, texture settings, and build stripping are unverified.
estimates.sourcePayload: Exact tracked file byte size at the audited commit.
